plan.tagline: Automate overdue invoice reminders for freelancers and small businesses.
plan.problem: Freelancers and small businesses lose revenue due to unpaid invoices and manual follow-ups.
plan.solution: Tracks invoices, sends automated polite reminders, and generates reports—all via a simple CLI tool.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small business owners who invoice clients globally.
plan.demo_script: Run `invoicechase --demo` to see 3 mock invoices with automated reminders sent to a local SQLite DB.
plan.phuket_angle: Perfect for Phuket-based freelancers (e.g., dive instructors, digital nomads) who invoice international clients and need automated, timezone-aware reminders.
